messages:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired -> PD#INC-8472: rate-limiter-high-429s for service=api-gateway. Triggers: 5xx->0, 429 rate increase across multiple regions. Impact: elevated 429s for ~30% of requests to /v1/generate for several tenants. Pager: PagerDuty.
PagerDuty: PD: alert auto-created and paging escalation started. Current escalation level: level-1 page to oncall.
Matt R: acked the PD page. I'm on it. any immediate customer reports?
Carmen L: seeing spikes from 12:03 UTC. Dashboards show limiter-service token-bucket depletion and a sudden spike in quota-mapper errors (500s). Some tenants getting misapplied quota values (0).
Jia P: logs from limiter show repeated "quota_lookup: tenant=acme-corp result=NULL" followed by immediate 429 returned. attaching a tail: ```[2026-01-04T12:03:11Z] limiter request tenant=acme-corp req_id=abcd1234 quota=0 -> 429; cause=quota-mapper:500/timeout```
Ben O: tagging EngOps. Could be config push or a rollout of quota-mapper v2 last night. Was there a canary?
Carmen L: There was a small canary at 03:00 UTC to rollout quota-mapper:v2. It passed smoke on canary but not full rollout. I see a surge in error rate after ~12:02 when rollout percentage increased to 40%.
Matt R: ok don't rollback yet. Let's triage. Jia, can you confirm whether limiter is correctly falling back on cached quotas?
Jia P: it should fallback on cache, but cache lookups are returning stale "nil" for a subset of tenants. I suspect a regression where the mapper now returns explicit NULL on cache-miss instead of previous behavior.
Matt R: moving to manual mitigation: 1) pause quota-mapper rollout, 2) enable limiter fallback to default-allow for enterprise tier, 3) restart limiter pods gradually. Carmen can you pause the rollout?
Carmen L: pausing rollout now via deploy service: `deployctl rollout pause quota-mapper --namespace=prod` -> done. CI shows pause acknowledged.
IncidentBot: PagerDuty: incident assigned to Matt R (oncall). Acknowledgement recorded. Escalation halted.
Matt R: applying temporary limiter policy override for enterprise tenants: run `kubectl apply -f - <<EOF
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: limiter-override
  namespace: prod
data:
  enterprise_default_quota: "1000"
EOF`
Carmen L: applied override, pushing to limiter-config-svc -> confirmed config version 2026-01-04-override-1.
Jia P: restarting limiter pods one at a time to pick up override. `kubectl rollout restart deployment/limiter --namespace=prod --timeout=5m` -> pod-1 restarted, pod-2 restarting.
Ben O: quick note — traffic shaping also bumped in EU region, ROI looks similar. Suggest we keep rollout paused until we confirm mapper fix.
Matt R: agreed. Jia, watch error rate and 429 rate for affected tenants. Carmen, check quota-mapper canary logs to see what caused NULL.
Jia P: after first pod restart, 429s for enterprise tenants dropped from 29% -> 6% in 2 minutes. Still seeing a small tail for a few tenants.
Carmen L: canary logs from quota-mapper:v2 show a new code path hitting a memcache client that returns explicit "nil" on timeout and quota-mapper then writes that nil into the cache. That explains persistent NULLs when limiter reads cache. Looks like a missing check.
Matt R: nice find. Can Eng fix quick? What's the risk of immediate rollback vs small code patch?
Ben O: rollback to v1 is fastest and lowest-risk. v2 introduced the memcache client change. Recommend full rollback of the rollout to 0% immediately.
Carmen L: rolling rollback now: `deployctl rollout set quota-mapper 0 --namespace=prod` -> initiating. Monitoring.
IncidentBot: PagerDuty note: manual action recorded: rollout set to 0%.
Jia P: observing cache being repopulated with previous values as v1 instances come back. 429s continue trending down.
Matt R: good. Matt to PD: I'll ack and keep incident open until full recovery and customer impact assess.
PagerDuty: PD: escalation suppressed while oncall has acknowledged. Next escalation timer paused.
Carmen L: rollback complete across all clusters. quota-mapper traffic back to v1. Error rate dropped to baseline within 3 minutes.
Jia P: running synthetic checks against top 10 enterprise tenants, all successful (200s). Sample logs show no NULL quotas.
Ben O: did we have any client-side retries or bursts that could have been overloaded during the 20-minute window? Need to check if any background job retried and caused more load.
Matt R: initial customer impact check: telemetry shows ~18 minutes of elevated 429s for ~2% of total customers, but ~6 enterprise tenants hit harder (their traffic had high tail). No full outages, but degraded performance for some. We're documenting affected tenants for outreach.
Carmen L: adding list: acme-corp, beta-retail, dataflux, lumen-ai, primepay, edu-synth. I'll create a ticket in incidents tracker with those.
Jia P: will run post-incident quick dump: `kubectl logs -l app=quota-mapper --since=30m | gzip > /tmp/qm-v2-dump.gz` and share in the incident ticket.
Matt R: notifications: Ops will send initial customer note to account owners for affected tenants. Customer success: flag high-touch accounts.
Ben O: action items immediate: 1) postmortem owner (Ben) 2) revert dangerous memcache write behavior in v2 before next canary 3) add a canary health-check to detect explicit NULL writes 4) add a limiter safety that ignores explicit nil cache entries.
IncidentBot: PagerDuty: oncall handoff scheduled in 2h. Current assignee: Matt R; next: Carmen L.
Carmen L: I'll take next oncall. Leaving notes and instructions in the incident ticket.
Matt R: thanks everyone. I'll keep the thread open for 30m to monitor for any regressions. Postmortem owner: Ben O. Expected P0 writeup in 48h, notify eng leads.
Jia P: dropping the collected logs and commands into the ticket now.
Matt R: closing mitigation: systems back to normal, rollout paused and rolled back, config override removed (limiter reading default again). Will update PD with resolution note after postmortem link created. :white_check_mark:
PagerDuty: Incident PD-INC-8472 marked as resolved by Matt R (resolution: rollback quota-mapper v2; config override; limiter restart).
Carmen L: thanks team. Follow-up: schedule a deep-dive with quota-mapper engineers and SRE to tighten canary gating.
Ben O: noted — will schedule and include remediation checklist.
Matt R: handoff to Carmen in thread. Carmen please watch dashboards for the next 2 hours and escalate if anything reappears.
Carmen L: will do.
